scripts.preview: GENSHIN_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=preview opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: GENSHIN_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=production opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env ""
scripts.deploy:staging: GENSHIN_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=preview opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.verify:bundle: GENSHIN_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=production opennextjs-cloudflare build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --env ""
